items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where did Bichet live when you were a boy? [INTERVIEWEE] On Oakwood Street, yeah. He lived on Monroir Street.

ctx.x: Same name. He was a valto. Now I had another fellow, a cousin of mine, he was an old age of a man, Amarjan they used to call him in French, Amarjan. He was a great violinist too. Oh, he had loved violin. He could play violin.
Where did Bichet live when you were a boy?

On Oakwood Street, yeah. He lived on Monroir Street. Then they moved to, his brother moved to St. Menard Street, but his brother got rid of him then. He moved to St. Menard and Moray. And from St. Menard and Moray he moved to St. Menard and Villaray.
